function.description: Calculate the resonant frequency of an LC (inductor-capacitor) circuit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

capacitance.description: The capacitance (C) in farads (F). This is a float type value.

round_off.description: Rounding off the result to a certain decimal places, default is 2.
